articles.summary: Coinrule lets users build trading strategies through a visual rule engine, with no coding required. Traders can set conditions like price movements, indicator signals, time-based triggers, and allocation rules, applying them to individual stocks or entire baskets. You can create custom strategies around your own market views or deploy professionally designed templates based on proven systematic approaches. On NYSE assets, popular strategies include trend-following systems for large-cap equities, mean-reversion logic on index ETFs, and volatility-driven rotation between defensive and cyclical sectors.Rather than relying on synthetic pricing, Coinrule connects directly to regulated brokerage partners so trades execute at the broker level. Supported brokers currently include Alpaca, Trading212, Public, Tradier, TastyTrade, and Webull, giving users access to U.S. equities across both NYSE and NASDAQ listings.
